content: LiveView Streams (Phoenix.LiveView.stream/4) avoid full-collection diffing by tracking individual item operations; recommended for all rendered collections regardless of size to keep memory/diff cost flat. Combined with LiveView 0.20+ async assigns (assign_async / start_async) for non-Oban short-lived async work, while Oban remains the tool for anything that must survive process crashes, needs retries, or takes long enough to risk a LiveView process timeout (embeddings, LLM calls, RAG retrieval).
